changes: HungerStation edit-sheet reader keeps repeated required headings as separate groups and treats any heading with an explicit limit as optional.
Keeta header matching accepts campaign suffixes through KeetaRestaurantName.
Configured Keeta path scrolls to the requested row before proving an empty cart and reverses once at the list end.
Keeta meal choices key repeated headings by first row, strip BOM and bidi marks, and accept a preselected single-row required group.
A Terra refusal is advisory and no longer ends a comparison.
Returning to the HungerStation menu waits for the cart bar count before proving the cart.
Home keeps the last result for the same order with its read time instead of hiding it after two minutes.

physical.build: local diagnostic build of the same source, stable preview signing

limitations: Configured transfer remains one meal, quantity one, with required single-choice selections.
Verified on KFC only; other restaurants and optional additions are not proven.
A Keeta cart emptied by hand needs the in-app emptied-cart confirmation before the next run.
privacy: No account data, addresses, tokens, private captures or signing material included.
